findings.text: Section 2's 'present barrier' lists three quantities as reasons 'a certificate rung above ~1000 cells cannot be compiled within the section 6 clauses', the second being 'executable 36.9 MB against a 50 MB clause at the smallest rung'; but 36.9 MB is below 50 MB, and docs/plans/converged-forward-solve.html records that the 50 MB half of the clause 'is inert because it measures XLA generated code size, not the serialized executable' (about 14 KB at the 132-cell rung, repaired in the wrap node), so by its own definition that clause is not breached. The report's own row 7 carries both numbers (36,892,631 B serialized against 14,062 B generated code) but section 2 does not reconcile them, so the summary reads as a clause violation the plan's qualification record contradicts.

Section 3 group B, 'goals that would disappear', lists f-cca-resolution-ladder as a followup whose goal 'changes from measurement to a refutation check' at a 2,000-10,000-cell carrier, but docs/plans/cut-cell-current-attribution.html already carries that FU as data-status=resolved (resolved 2026-09-19T10:51:46), its premise having been refuted by the plan's own review; the item is therefore already closed rather than a live goal that a resolution pivot would change, and presenting it beside genuinely open group-B items invites a reader to treat resolved work as outstanding.

justifications.evidence: The cited numbers reproduce: the axis-error ladder 13.4/30.2/52.4/62.7 mm, the graded-layer review's own 104/120 with base 646b68b8 and head 6cde21247 and added_failure_count 0, the equation counts 1,518,527 and 1,499,787, the fixed-point walls 1029.443/1047.387/1074.164 s, the 4.34 GB and 19.2 GiB and 279 GiB figures, revert 2992599ff and the four f-cca followups all resolve in the sources named, and every inference is fenced from measurement and itemised in section 4; the report is docked because section 2's barrier summary states the 36.9 MB serialized executable against the 50 MB clause as a breach while the plan's own qualification record holds that clause inert.
justifications.fit: The report answers the pivot question head-on, which mechanisms are coarse-carrier artefacts and which are representation or physics requirements that persist at any resolution, and states the single most decision-relevant finding explicitly: the compile barrier is a mixture of a cell-count-flat kernel cost and a genuine carrier-size literal/serialization cost, which is exactly the distinction the 2,000-10,000-cell decision turns on.

justifications.reuse: The work aggregates existing plans, evidence fragments, research records, ledger rows and a prior review's stored scores rather than re-deriving any of them, cites the graded-layer review's own 104/120 verbatim, and invents no new measurement, script or receipt, so a reader is pointed at the durable source for every claim.
